Name: Adventurer's Interface
Author: medicsun
Description:
[left][size=3]An interface made with books, paper scraps, & ornate style frames.[/size]


[size=5][b]More about the UI :[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]I like the saturated colors of vanilla, so I'm unsure if I will make a dark/desaturated version of this UI[/*]
[*]This mod uses the vanilla background color, so you don't need to disable Font Shadow if you're using Font Settings (if you prefer that)[/*]
[*]Has all the base-game translations (using only it's provided text, so the quest board of papers is still english)[/*]
[*]I haven't reached all of 1.6 yet, so some UI elements may be missed or seem out of place, report these to me with a screenshot :)[/*]
[/list]

[b]
For Compatibility Overwrites : 
[/b]Unzip the compatibility folder, find the mods you have installed and move them into your mod folder.
Allow it to overwrite files.
I recommend you keep a backup of the zip so you can redo if one of those mods update.[/size]
